main_text.p: Ita Haman Agagites hostis Iudæorū, traditus fuit in manus Mardochæi: & duo senes, iudices iniusti, in manus Danielis.

6. Actum pijs solicitè spectādum, quid priuatam personam, & quid Magistratu fungentem, deceat. Etenim Magistratū in homines facinorosos, diuinitus (id quod ex mirandis occasionibus liquet) in manus traditos, animaduertere, iustū & laudabile est. Ut rectè fecit Dauid, supplicio afficiēs nefarios illos latrones, Banam & Rechab, qui Isbosethum truci-dauerant, suæ domi quiescentem. 1. Re-gum 4.10.11.12.

Econtrà grauiter peccauit Saul, cui cū in manus traditus esset Agag Amelecitarum Rex plectendus, pepercit hosti impio. 1.Sam.15.9. Saulis clementiam præposteram ij imitatur, qui blasphemis hæresiarchis, cōtumeliosis[?] in filium Dei, & convictis, nec tamen Deo gloriam dantibus, sed virus suum spargentibus, & simplices ac imperitos seducentibus, parcendum esse iudicant: cotra expressum Dei

page.notes: Long s is printed as f throughout and has been transcribed as s. The first word of the continued line ("unfto") is read as "unsto" with a doubtful letter. The macron over "cotumeliosis" is uncertain. The hyphens in "truci-dauerant", "Re-gum" and "edi-" are printed line-end hyphens. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
